facts.text: Under the Western Undergraduate Exchange at the University of Idaho, eligible nonresident students are assessed 150% of the full-time undergraduate tuition rate instead of standard nonresident tuition.

sources.title: Fees, Expenses, and Aid | University of Idaho Catalog
sources.quote: The Western Undergraduate Exchange Program fee is calculated by taking 150% of the institution's full-time undergraduate tuition rate. This fee is in addition to the undergraduate student fees. Nonresident tuition is not assessed to WUE students.
